repository.name: @webex/plugin-logger
repository.purpose: Logger plugin for the Cisco Webex JS SDK. It replaces the minimal webex-core logger with leveled console output, redaction of authorization keys, email addresses, and MTID values, and in-memory log buffers that internal-plugin-support formats and uploads.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-logger package barrel
public_interfaces.audience: 14 workspace packages that depend on @webex/plugin-logger, plus external npm consumers
public_interfaces.notes: Default export Logger and named export levels. Importing the package also registers Logger as the webex 'logger' plugin with replace: true.

public_interfaces.name: webex.logger runtime methods
public_interfaces.notes: One method per level and one client_ twin per level: group, groupEnd, error, warn, log, info, debug, trace. error and client_error are listed as representatives. Config keys read: level, clientLevel, bufferLogLevel, historyLength, clientHistoryLength, separateLogBuffers, clientName.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: Do not run the aggregate test script: it chains test:integration, which is not defined.

refresh_with: update alongside the behavior change in the same commit

change_impact.notes: Redaction, buffer entry layout, and formatLogs output are relied on by consumers and by the uploaded log text.

affects: webex.logger resolution in every webex instance
change_impact.notes: Dropping replace: true leaves the @webex/webex-core fallback logger in place.

evidence_rules.requirement: The script must exist in package.json scripts. test:integration is referenced by test but undefined.
evidence_rules.notes: Never cite the aggregate test script as runnable.

evidence_rules.requirement: A binding is public only if exported from src/index.js.
evidence_rules.notes: Consumers import from the package root; there are no subpath entry points.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not an evidence source for this package. README.md is retained product documentation, not the behavioral authority.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add an output path that skips Logger#filter.
negative_guidance.why: filter is the only place authorization keys, emails, and MTID values are removed.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change the buffer entry layout or the timestamp position.
negative_guidance.why: formatLogs merges separate buffers by entry index 1 and internal-plugin-support uploads the joined text.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not remove replace: true from registerPlugin.
negative_guidance.why: @webex/webex-core registers a fallback logger first; without replace the plugin is not installed.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not let a log method throw.
negative_guidance.why: Callers log inside error paths; makeLoggerMethod catches and reports through console.warn.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the list of supported levels or config keys.
negative_guidance.why: It omits group, groupEnd, client_ methods, buffers, and five of the seven config keys. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

high.expectation: Source and test evidence both support the change, and the affected behavior has a unit case in test/unit/spec/logger.js.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example registration, the catch branch, or group indentation. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
